name: pcb-designer
description: Professional PCB design agent for rapid prototyping on Anna OS. 1.0.7 adds ESP32 support.
author: assalas

credentials.name: OCTOPART_API_KEY
credentials.description: Optional: Octopart API key for live vendor BOM lookups

tools.name: parse_requirements
tools.description: Extract structured component requirements from a natural-language hardware description. Uses deep LLM reasoning (via Anna sampling) with thorough chain-of-thought analysis for MCU selection, voltage domains, and LPKF constraints.

tools.name: generate_bom
tools.description: Generate a Bill of Materials from structured requirements. Queries Octopart when credentials available, falls back to built-in catalog.

tools.name: extract_package_from_pdf
tools.description: Deep extraction of package dimensions from a component datasheet PDF. Multi-stage pipeline: text extraction, OCR fallback, LLM-powered dimensional analysis with thorough reasoning for mechanical drawings.

tools.name: generate_footprint
tools.description: Generate a KiCad .kicad_mod footprint file. Supports: qfn, qfp, soic, smd_rc, bga, dip, usbc, header, custom.

tools.name: synthesize_netlist
tools.description: Generate a SKiDL netlist from a BOM with automatic decoupling and buck converter support circuits.

tools.name: route_pcb
tools.description: Route a PCB board from a netlist using KiCad pcbnew with smart heuristic placement and optional Manhattan routing.

tools.name: full_pipeline
tools.description: Run the complete end-to-end pipeline: NL description to requirements to BOM to netlist to board layout. Includes comprehensive engineering analysis report with LPKF manufacturability assessment.
